question: Is AIC valid AND endpoint_data_type declared as required?
rationale: Without AIC, no decision is meaningful.
detection_rule: A0_state != AIC-MISSING AND (endpoint_data_type declared when A0 in [AIC-PKPD,AIC-ER,AIC-TTE,AIC-BIOMARKER,AIC-CELL_THERAPY,AIC-IMMUNOGEN,AIC-LACTATION])

question: Is subject identifier resolvable (including dyad linkage for MATERNAL_INFANT_PK)?
rationale: ID failure -> INVALID; dyad-key failure -> Q18.
detection_rule: A1_state in [ID-DEFINED,ID-DUPLICATE-RESOLVABLE,ID-DYAD-LINKABLE] AND (if MATERNAL_INFANT_PK: dyad_linkage_key present)

question: Is time axis resolvable (actual/nominal/elapsed/postpartum)?
rationale: Time path determines event ordering; v4.2 adds postpartum anchor.
detection_rule: A2_state in [TIME-DEFINED,TIME-ACTUAL-VS-NOMINAL-RESOLVABLE,TIME-INTERVAL-RESOLVABLE,TIME-ELAPSED-RESOLVABLE] AND (delivery_anchor present if pregnancy/lactation)

question: Is dose record complete (regimen + infusion + ADDL)?
rationale: Dose path failure -> false REPAIR risk highest.
detection_rule: A3_state not in [DOSE-UNRECOVERABLE,DOSE-AMBIGUOUS] AND A4_state not in [MISSING-NO-POLICY,UNRECOVERABLE,ADDL-ACTUAL-CONFLICT(no policy),TITRATION-ADAPTIVE(no policy),LOADING-MAINTENANCE(no policy),INFUSION-STOP-RESTART(no policy)]
v5_1_note: v5.1 cost raised from 3.6 due to v4.2 dose paths

question: Is observation/CMT resolvable (including analyte_role)?
rationale: v4.2 cellular/immunogen/milk silent error mostly happens here.
detection_rule: A5_state not in [ABSENT,BIOANALYTICAL-FINAL-FLAG-MISSING,BLQ-NO-POLICY,LLOQ-MISSING,CELLULAR-LLOQ-POLICY-MISSING,IMMUNOGEN-POSITIVITY-MISSING] AND A8_state != CMT-POLICY-MISSING AND (analyte_role declared when modality in [ADC,BISPECIFIC,CELL_THERAPY] AND A8 in [MULTI-CMT-DEFINED,DDI-VICTIM-PERPETRATOR,METABOLITE-DEFINED])
v5_1_note: v5.1 cost raised from 3.2 due to v4.2 endpoint subtypes

question: Is BLQ/MDV policy applied?
detection_rule: A5_state not in [BLQ-NO-POLICY,LLOQ-MISSING,CELLULAR-LLOQ-POLICY-MISSING] AND (cellular_LLOQ present if cellular endpoint)

question: Is covariate attachment resolvable (incl. product-level for CAR-T)?
detection_rule: A6_state != COVARIATE-IMPUTATION-POLICY-MISSING AND A7_state not in [KEY-MISSING,POLICY-MISSING] AND (product_level_linkage present if PRODUCT-LEVEL-COVARIATE)

question: Are ALL required_policies for proposed action_sequence declared in AIC?
rationale: Explicit gate catching partial policy declarations.
detection_rule: All required_policy fields of all functions in expected_action_sequence are present in AIC (non-null/non-empty)

question: is_endpoint CELLULAR_KINETICS?
rationale: Distinguishes cellular-kinetics path from other endpoints.
v5_1_note: v5.1 P92 patch — added to resolve infeasible pairs

question: is_v4.2 modality (ADC/BISPECIFIC/CELL/GENE/MRNA)?
detection_rule: modality_class in [ADC, BISPECIFIC, CELL_THERAPY, GENE_THERAPY, MRNA]

question: Does sequence include dose reconstruction?
detection_rule: action_sequence contains any of reconstruct_dose_* / expand_addl_ii / resolve_addl_actual_conflict

question: Does sequence include reanalysis final selection?
Does sequence include postpartum/elapsed time anchor?
Does sequence include any multi-CMT assignment?
Does sequence include any covariate attachment?
rationale: Distinguishes product-level / time-varying / external covariate scenarios.

question: Is A5=BIOANALYTICAL-FINAL-FLAG-MISSING?
rationale: Distinguishes Q15A (data package incomplete) from other quarantines.

question: Is A8 multi-CMT-class state (drives analyte_role check)?
Is A8=DDI-VICTIM-PERPETRATOR?
rationale: Distinguishes DDI dual-CMT from other multi-CMT.

question: Is A4=ADDL-ACTUAL-CONFLICT?
rationale: Distinguishes ADDL-conflict paths from other regimen paths.

question: Sequence contains assign_cmt_with_analyte_role?
rationale: Distinguishes role-tagged CMT vs plain multi-CMT.

question: Sequence contains canonicalize_cellular_blq specifically?
rationale: Distinguishes cellular BLQ function from concentration BLQ.

question: Sequence contains adjudicate_immunogenicity_positivity?
rationale: Distinguishes ADA-adjudication paths from clean immunogenicity.
